meta.description: Additional lunar south-polar candidate, study and mission points (plus a few mission points between 65 and 71 S) whose coordinates are printed in a primary or official source, collected 14 Nov 2026.
meta.coordinate_convention: Decimal degrees; latitude south negative; longitude east-positive, given as lon_east_180 (-180..180) and lon_east_360 (0..360). The NASA Lunar Surface Data Book and De Rosa et al. 2012 print signed decimal degrees in -180..180 (used unchanged). Hemmi et al. 2025 prints degrees S and 0-360 E (kept in properties only, it matches De Rosa). Stooke et al. 2021 prints S/W, NSSDCA, LROC and JAXA print S/E: S and W were converted to negative values, nothing else was changed. lon_east_360 = lon_east_180 + 360 where negative.
meta.validation: Coordinates read from the cited pages on 14 Nov 2026 by an AI agent. Not validated by the science lead. Coordinates need a check before use in the app.
source_meta_notes: PGDA product 78 centres: NASA Lunar Surface Data Book (ACD-50044 Rev. A) Table A2-2, pp. 57-58, verified against the two app sites (Site04 -89.7668/-171.87 and Site23 -85.9948/-0.23578 match exactly; both skipped as already in scripts/sites.csv). Section A2.1 says the coordinates were generated from the DEM files at https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/81 (product 81 is the 'South Pole LOLA DEM Mosaic'), not product 78; the shorthand names match product 78 site IDs.

Table A2-2 values equal the 'computed from Trek polygon' centres already in landing-sites.json for 13 Artemis regions (to 3 decimals). Those were researcher-computed; the pgda78_*_centre items add the NASA-printed value. They are flagged in properties.same_position_within_0_01_deg.

De Rosa et al. 2012 Table 2 (arXiv 1208.5587): 12 ESA Lunar Lander ROI centres; the six IDs CR1, GR1, GR2, LP1, MP1, MP2 are printed with identical values in Hemmi et al. 2025 (PSJ 6, 264) Table 1, which JAXA's JLPEDA page labels LUPEX candidate sites.

WebFetch stored local copies of six PDFs it opened in the Claude Code tool-results cache outside the repo (Data Book, Stooke 2021, De Rosa 2012 preprint, two Copernicus abstracts, IM-1 press kit); those copies were read to quote the tables. Nothing was written into the repo except this file.

Failed: Wueller et al. 2026, https://agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1029/2025JE009434 - HTTP 403 again; ZORA record https://www.zora.uzh.ch/entities/publication/8cb53391-9547-43db-a9de-dc6baf79f78a - bot-protection page; companion shapefile https://zenodo.org/records/17084058 is a download (not done).
Failed: Flahaut et al. 2020 ROIs, https://hal.archives-ouvertes.fr/hal-02345336/file/for%20HAL.pdf - bot-protection page (Anubis), not bypassed.

Failed: Luna-27 sites. Turchinskaya and Slyuta 2024 (doi:10.1016/j.actaastro.2024.06.011) full text not reachable (x-mol page shows no content); EGU2022-5452, EGU2019-8924 and EPSC2018-1015 abstracts give no coordinates.
Failed: LUPEX. JAXA JLPEDA page and Zenodo record 17153447 give no coordinates (ROI polygons are in a 76 MB zip, not downloaded); centres found only via De Rosa/Hemmi tables (see above).
Failed: Griffin Mission One, Blue Moon MK1, IM-4, Blue Ghost 4, Chang'e-8: no primary page with a landing coordinate found.

Not added: Lemelin et al. 2021 PSJ (https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.3847/PSJ/abf3c5) Tables 1-4 list PSR sampling targets with coordinates (some already in psr-cold-traps.json as lem21_*); they are PSRs, not landing points.
Failed: LUVMI-X candidate sites, https://oro.open.ac.uk/87053 - HTTP 403.

Not added: Table 3 of the TOPSIS study (https://arxiv.org/html/2406.19863v2) has 20 ranked points in degrees-minutes-seconds; the best point per region is already in landing-sites.json (topsis_*); the other 14 rows are lower-ranked, 8 of them DM2 points within about 1 km of the existing best point.

Failed: PSJ papers on sites 001/004 (https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.3847/PSJ/aca590) and south-polar areas of interest (https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.3847/PSJ/ad8fb0) - redirected to a Radware bot-check page, not followed.

Failed: Lemelin et al. 2014 regions (NASA-hosted LEAG slides https://lunarvolatiles.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/46/2018/12/Regions-of-Interest-LEAG_Lemelin.pdf) - HTTP 403; journal article paywalled.

No coordinates: IM-1 intended site (NASA LRO page https://www.nasa.gov/missions/lro/nasas-lro-images-intuitive-machines-odysseus-lander/ and IM-1 press kit say only 'near Malapert A'); NTRS white paper 'Lunar Site Selection' (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20230016267) abstract has none; Chang'e-7: no CNSA or peer-reviewed page with a landing coordinate found (existing change_7_intended stays unofficial).

items.name: Chandrayaan-1 Moon Impact Probe impact site (Jawahar Point), refined
items.location_note: Stooke, Ahmed and Subramanian, LPSC 52 (2021) abstract 1013, Introduction: 'Impact occurred on the Earth-facing slope of the Connecting Ridge (Spudis Ridge) near 89.55° S, 122.93° W'. Converted: S -> negative latitude, W -> negative longitude.
items.limitations: Approximate impact point projected downrange of the last MIP image; the abstract says the impact crater 'has not yet been found in LROC NAC images'. Not an ISRO-published value.
